chunk: Michaela Oneill was born on April 9, 2004, in Washington. Growing up, she was fascinated by birds and spent most of her childhood watching and learning about different species. This curiosity led her to start training birds at a young age, and by the time she was 10, she had already won several local competitions.
As she entered her teenage years, Michaela discovered her passion for weightlifting. She joined a local gym and began training under the guidance of a professional coach
